verbatim_critique: [D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves population identification of the complete SEM explanation, sound-and-complete exact membership certification, and deterministic discrete stability on the observed-coordinate fully covered class, while its counterexamples and rank-only impossibility transfer negatively to the broader published class. It does not prove an estimator or operator-error tail for recovering the unordered Gaussian components from pooled samples, so the statistical problem ends at an oracle covariance interface and the causaldag application remains a semantic validation proposal rather than an operational workflow. The exact-equality, real-arithmetic certificate also supplies neither finite-precision acceptance guarantees nor approximate membership control. The framing consistently discloses these limits and does not present the open growing-mixture tail as established, but the narrow fully covered Gaussian scope and missing end-to-end statistical guarantee constrain significance at a leading econometrics journal. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.8 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
